name: network-blocked
description: A run_command step whose output carries a Class 2 environment-block signature (docs/02 §11, docs/03 §2) — the sandbox blocks DNS resolution silently. No hook fires, exit stays 0, result.status stays SUCCESS: only the ordinary tool output reveals the block. The command must be one the gate actually lets through, otherwise the step becomes a Class 1 denial and the scripted output is never emitted — `curl` is in HARD_DENY, `git ls-remote` falls to general_worker's default 'ask'. Used to test events/detect.ts scanDenials() and that verified_success is withheld.

steps.output: fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/example/repo.git/': Could not resolve host: github.com

chunks: The git ls-remote command failed with a DNS resolution error, so I could not reach the remote.

turns.response: The git ls-remote command failed with a DNS resolution error, so I could not reach the remote.
